Disturbance Explorer Report

Date: 2026-06-02

This report summaries disturbance metrics for the chosen study area. The range spans 13200 km², of which 82.3% is classified as undisturbed and 17.7% as disturbed. In this analysis, disturbed areas include only features selected for this assessment: buffered anthropogenic disturbances and natural disturbances (fires). Undisturbed areas are defined as all remaining portions of the study area not intersected by these selected disturbances, regardless of the presence of other disturbance types that may exist within the study area but were not included in the analysis.

Anthropogenic disturbances include 1032.7 km of linear features, 9.0 km² of areal disturbances and 950.4 km² of mining claims.

To generate the disturbed areas layer, a generic buffer of 500 m for linear features and 500 m for areal disturbances were used. Additional features include: mining claims buffered with a 1450 m distance and fires that had a minimal size of 0 m and restricted to the period 1951 - 2024.

No protected areas intersect the study area.
